name: Back Squat
instructions: Bar on upper back, brace, sit down between your hips, drive the floor away. Depth just below parallel.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Bar racked on front delts, elbows high, torso tall. Great upright-posture squat.

name: Bench Press
instructions: Shoulder blades pinned, feet planted, touch mid-chest, press to lockout. Control every inch.

name: Incline Bench Press
instructions: Bench at 30-45°, touch just below the collarbone, press up and slightly back.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Standing, glutes tight, bar from collarbone to lockout overhead. No leg drive.

name: Push Press
instructions: Small knee dip then drive the bar overhead explosively. Power expression for the press.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge to ~45°, pull the bar to your lower ribs, control down. No heaving.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Bar over mid-foot, wedge in, push the floor away and stand tall. Reset each rep.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Soft knees, push hips back until hamstrings load, stand by squeezing glutes. Bar stays close.

name: Good Morning
instructions: Bar on back, hinge until torso nears parallel, drive hips forward to stand. Light and strict.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on the bench, bar over hips, drive to a full glute squeeze with ribs down.

name: Barbell Lunge
instructions: Bar on back, long step, back knee to just off the floor, push through the front foot.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Hands just inside shoulder width, elbows tucked, touch low on the chest.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Elbows pinned to your sides, curl without swinging, full stretch at the bottom.

name: Skullcrusher
instructions: Lower the bar to your forehead with elbows fixed, extend back up. Slow negatives.

name: Barbell Calf Raise
instructions: Bar on back, rise to full tiptoe, pause, lower to a deep stretch.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Stand tall, shrug shoulders straight up, pause, lower fully. No rolling.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Stand in the middle, neutral spine, drive the floor away. The ground-force builder for the golf swing.

name: Trap Bar Jump
instructions: Light load (~20-30% DL). Dip and jump for maximum height, land soft, reset fully. Speed is the point.

name: Trap Bar Carry
instructions: Deadlift it up, walk tall for distance or time. Heavy grip and trunk work.

name: Trap Bar RDL
instructions: From standing, push hips back with soft knees, load the hamstrings, stand tall.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your chest, squat between your hips, elbows inside knees at the bottom.

name: DB Bench Press
instructions: Dumbbells over the chest, lower to a comfortable stretch, press up and slightly in.

name: Incline DB Press
instructions: Bench at 30-45°, press dumbbells from shoulder level to over the upper chest.

name: Seated DB Shoulder Press
instructions: Seated, back supported, press dumbbells from ears to overhead without shrugging.

name: One-Arm DB Row
instructions: Hand and knee on the bench, pull the dumbbell to your hip, no torso twist.

name: Chest-Supported DB Row
instructions: Chest on an incline bench, row both dumbbells to your ribs, squeeze the blades.

name: DB Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Dumbbells in front of thighs, hips back, flat back, stand by squeezing glutes.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot on the bench, drop straight down, drive through the front foot. Brutal and worth it.

name: DB Walking Lunge
instructions: Dumbbells at sides, long alternating steps, back knee kisses the floor.

name: DB Reverse Lunge
instructions: Step back, lower under control, push through the front heel to return. Knee-friendly lunge.

name: DB Step-Up
instructions: Step onto the bench, drive through the top foot only — don't push off the floor leg.

name: Single-Leg RDL
instructions: Hinge on one leg, free leg reaches back, dumbbell tracks the standing leg. Balance = trail-side power.

name: DB Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on the bench, dumbbell on hips, squeeze to full extension, pause at the top.

name: DB Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise to shoulder height with soft elbows, lead with the elbows, lower slow.

name: DB Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Chest on an incline bench or hinged over, open the arms wide, thumbs up.

name: DB Curl
instructions: Curl with elbows pinned, rotate palms up through the rep, control the negative.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Neutral grip, curl without swinging. Forearm strength that carries to the club.

name: DB Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: One dumbbell held overhead in both hands, lower behind the head, extend to lockout.

name: DB Fly
instructions: Slight elbow bend, open to a deep chest stretch, hug back up.

name: DB Pullover
instructions: Lying across the bench, lower one dumbbell behind your head to a big lat stretch, pull back over.

name: Farmer Carry
instructions: Heavy dumbbell in each hand, walk tall. Grip, trunk, and posture in one move.

name: Suitcase Carry
instructions: One heavy dumbbell, walk tall without leaning. Anti-lateral-flexion the swing needs.

name: DB Shrug
instructions: Dumbbells at sides, shrug straight up, pause, lower fully.

name: DB Calf Raise
instructions: Dumbbell in one hand, ball of foot on a plate or step, full stretch to full tiptoe.

name: DB Thruster
instructions: Front squat into an overhead press in one flow. Conditioning staple.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Overhand grip, pull chest to the bar, full hang at the bottom. Add weight when 10+ get easy.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Underhand grip, pull until your chin clears, control the descent. Add weight when strong.

name: Band-Assisted Chin-Up
instructions: Band looped over the bar under one knee. The path to a first unassisted rep.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Dead hang, curl knees to chest without swinging, lower slow.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Straight legs to parallel or higher, zero swing. Earned after knee raises.

name: Dead Hang
instructions: Hang with relaxed shoulders breathing slow. Grip endurance and a free shoulder decompression.

name: Dips
instructions: Lean slightly forward, lower to a comfortable shoulder depth, press to lockout.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Rigid plank, chest to the floor, full lockout. Elevate hands to regress, elevate feet to progress.

name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Hands on the bench, body rigid, chest to the edge. The stepping stone to floor push-ups.

name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Hips high in a pike, lower the crown of your head toward the floor, press back.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Arms forward for balance, full-depth squat, stand tall. The movement before the load.

name: Split Squat
instructions: Static lunge stance, drop straight down and up. Master before loading.

name: Nordic Curl
instructions: Ankles anchored, lower your torso forward as slowly as possible, push back up. Few reps, big payoff.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: On your back, drive hips to full extension, squeeze for a beat, lower.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms down, one straight line, glutes and abs on. Quality seconds only.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Stacked feet, hips tall, straight line from ear to ankle. Anti-lateral strength for the swing.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Low back pressed to the floor, opposite arm and leg extend slow, exhale fully.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: Quadruped, opposite arm and leg reach long, pause, switch without wobbling.

name: Hollow Hold
instructions: Low back glued down, arms and legs long and hovering. Shake means it's working.

name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Side plank with the top foot on the bench. Adductor armor for rotation athletes.

name: Box Jump
instructions: Jump onto a sturdy surface, land soft and tall, step down. Max intent, full rest, ≤3 per set.

name: Broad Jump
instructions: Swing, load, jump for distance, stick the landing. Horizontal impulse — the #1 speed correlate.

name: Vertical Jump
instructions: Countermovement, jump as high as possible, soft landing. Full recovery between reps.

name: Pogo Hops
instructions: Stiff-ankle bounces off the ball of the foot, minimal knee bend, quick off the floor.

name: Lateral Bound
instructions: Push off one leg sideways, stick the landing on the other, pause, rebound. Trail-to-lead-leg transfer.

name: Burpee
instructions: Chest to floor, snap up, jump. Pace yourself — smooth is fast.

name: MB Rotational Scoop Toss
instructions: Golf-posture setup, load the trail hip, rip the ball into the wall from your hips. Max speed, full rest.

name: MB Side Scoop Throw
instructions: Ball at the hip, step and throw sideways with full hip drive — the swing's power pattern, heavier.

name: MB Step-Behind Rotational Throw
instructions: Shuffle step behind, then launch the ball rotationally. Adds momentum like a step-in drive.

name: MB Half-Kneeling Rotational Throw
instructions: Inside knee down, rotate and throw without the lower body — isolates thoracic rotation power.

name: MB Overhead Slam
instructions: Ball overhead on tiptoes, slam through the floor with everything. Full-body extension-to-flexion power.

name: MB Chest Pass
instructions: Explosive two-hand pass into the wall from an athletic stance. Upper-body speed work.

name: MB Granny Toss
instructions: Squat, then launch the ball straight up with full hip extension. Jump-impulse training with a ball.

name: MB Russian Twist
instructions: Seated lean-back, rotate the ball side to side with a tall chest. Controlled, not frantic.

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Band anchored at chest height, press arms out and resist the pull. The anti-rotation staple.

name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
instructions: Inside knee down, press and hold against the band. Hip and trunk stability together.

name: Band Chop
instructions: Band anchored high, pull down and across your body with straight-ish arms, rotate through the trunk.

name: Band Lift
instructions: Band anchored low, drive up and across — the follow-through pattern under load.

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Arms straight at shoulder height, pull the band to your chest, squeeze the blades. Posture medicine.

name: Band Face Pull
instructions: Band at face height, pull toward your eyes with elbows high, external-rotate at the end.

name: Band Row
instructions: Band anchored at waist height, row to your ribs with a tall chest.

name: Band Lateral Walk
instructions: Band around knees or ankles, athletic stance, step sideways keeping tension. Glute med wake-up.

name: Band External Rotation
instructions: Elbow pinned at your side, rotate the forearm out against the band. Cuff insurance.

name: Band Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Band anchored high, elbows pinned, extend to lockout.

name: Banded Hinge
instructions: Band around hips anchored behind, hinge and snap the hips through. Speed hinge, easy on recovery.

name: Banded Power Squat
instructions: Stand on the band, bar-less speed squats against rising tension. Move fast out of the hole.

name: 90/90 Hip Switch
instructions: Seated, both knees at 90°, rotate side to side keeping the chest tall. Internal + external hip rotation.

name: Hip Airplane
instructions: Single-leg hinge, rotate the hips open then closed over the standing leg. Balance and hip control.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: Deep lunge, elbow to instep, rotate to the sky. Hips, hamstrings, and T-spine in one flow.

name: Open Book
instructions: Side-lying, knees stacked at 90°, rotate the top arm open following it with your eyes. Hips stay still.

name: Quadruped T-Spine Rotation
instructions: Hand behind head, rotate elbow to the sky and back under. Pure thoracic turn — the backswing lives here.

name: Cat-Cow
instructions: Segment the spine slowly through flexion and extension with the breath.

name: Couch Stretch
instructions: Rear foot up the bench, squeeze the glute, grow tall. Hip-flexor opener for desk days.

name: Deep Squat Hold
instructions: Sit in the bottom of a squat, elbows pry knees out, breathe. Ankles and hips say thanks.

name: Ankle Rocks
instructions: Half-kneeling, drive the knee over the toes keeping the heel down. Ankle range = squat depth.

name: Shoulder CARs
instructions: Slow, biggest-possible arm circles with a braced trunk. Own every degree.

name: Treadmill Zone 2
instructions: 1-4% incline, pace where you can still talk in sentences. Nose-breathing effort, 30-45 min.

name: Treadmill Incline Walk
instructions: Brisk walk at a healthy incline. Zone 2 without jogging — joint-friendly engine building.

name: Norwegian 4×4 Intervals
instructions: 4 min hard (can't talk) + 3 min easy, four times. The proven VO₂max builder — earn it, don't force it.

name: Walk
instructions: Head outside and move. Steps are the quiet engine of everything else.
